name: pdf-field-filler
description: Safely inspect and fill AcroForm PDFs. List fields, validate values, and fill non-human-only fields — without flattening, signing, or touching signature/attestation fields.

tools.name: list_pdf_fields
tools.description: List every AcroForm field in a fillable PDF with exact internal names, types, current values, legal options, and widget locations. Read-only.

tools.name: validate_pdf_fill
tools.description: Validate proposed field values against the actual AcroForm field map without modifying the PDF. Flags signature, human-only, date, and attestation fields for review.

tools.name: fill_pdf_fields
tools.description: Fill validated, non-human-only fields into a fillable PDF. Never fills signature/initials/attestation/certification/signing-date fields. Writes atomically with auto-rollback.

tools.name: export_pdf_field_map
tools.description: Write the full field map of a PDF to a local JSON file. Includes PDF identity and server version.

allowed_dirs.title: Allowed Directories
allowed_dirs.description: Comma-separated absolute paths the server may read from and write to (e.g. /Users/you/Downloads,/Users/you/Documents). Leave blank to use the defaults: ~/Downloads and ~/Documents.
